categories.main_business_segments: The company primarily operates in tire manufacturing, producing radial car tires, radial truck tires, motorcycle tires, bicycle tires, inner tubes, and other tire products. It also engages in manufacturing other rubber products, adhesive tapes, machinery equipment, petroleum product wholesale and retail, and international trade. The company focuses on developing high-performance, lightweight, low rolling resistance, safe, and intelligent tires to expand its market share.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company employs advanced radial tire manufacturing technology, including steel-belted radial tires and low rolling resistance designs. Production processes involve raw material mixing, extrusion, assembly, vulcanization, and quality inspections such as leak and uniformity tests. The company emphasizes sustainable materials, including recycled carbon black and eco-friendly processing oils, and holds certifications like ISO9001, IATF16949, ISO14001, ISO45001, and ISO27001.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include original equipment manufacturers (OEMs) for automobiles, motorcycles, and bicycles, as well as aftermarket consumers globally. The company supplies major international car manufacturers such as BMW, General Motors, Toyota, Nissan, and Subaru. It also serves niche markets like electric vehicles, racing tires, and all-terrain vehicles, with products sold in over 180 countries worldwide.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates globally with manufacturing plants and sales offices in Taiwan, China, Indonesia, India, Vietnam, Thailand, Canada, the USA, Europe, and other regions. Its sales markets cover North America, Latin America, Europe, Middle East, Africa, Asia, and Oceania. The company emphasizes glocalization by combining global headquarters coordination with localized production and sales support.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates primarily in the midstream and downstream segments of the tire supply chain, focusing on manufacturing and assembly of tires and rubber products. It sources raw materials such as natural rubber, synthetic rubber, steel cords, and chemicals from upstream suppliers and delivers finished products to OEMs and aftermarket distributors. It also manages logistics and distribution through subsidiaries and trading companies.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include innovation in high-performance, all-season, electric vehicle tires, and off-road tires. The company invests about 4% of revenue in R&D to develop new products like low rolling resistance tires, advanced tread designs, and sustainable materials. It pursues sustainability through eco-friendly product development, energy efficiency, and circular economy initiatives. The company also focuses on strengthening global OEM partnerships and expanding brand recognition.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated mainly through product sales of tires and related rubber products to OEMs, distributors, and end consumers worldwide. The company also earns income from international trade and investment subsidiaries. It does not rely on subscription or licensing models but emphasizes volume sales combined with premium product positioning and after-sales services.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company is positioned as Taiwan's leading professional tire manufacturer and ranks as the 12th largest tire manufacturer globally. It competes with major global tire brands by focusing on quality, innovation, and competitive pricing. It has established strong OEM relationships with global automakers and maintains a leadership position in niche markets such as electric vehicle tires and racing tires.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: The company reported consolidated revenues of approximately NT$96.2 billion with a net profit growth of 11.53% year-over-year. It employs over 22,000 employees globally and maintains steady asset growth and profitability. The company invests significantly in capital expenditures and R&D to sustain growth and competitiveness, with a focus on expanding production capacity and market share internationally.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company emphasizes its core culture of '100% quality, 100% service, 100% trust' to differentiate its MAXXIS brand globally. It offers high-performance, durable, and environmentally friendly tires tailored to diverse market needs, including electric vehicles and all-terrain applications. Its commitment to sustainability, innovation, and customer satisfaction, combined with global OEM partnerships and extensive distribution networks, provides unique value to customers.
